title: Snapshot Inspector Interaction Regression — prototype handoff & stakeholder alignment
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: resolve an interaction regression in the Snapshot Inspector (compact mode) introduced by the density refactor, finalize a high-fidelity prototype for handoff, and collect stakeholder signoff across PM/Eng/SSO. This ticket captures design review notes, redlines, QA items, and the decisions that will land the change in console-2026.03 release.
updates: 2026-02-25: Ticket created after discovery session — QA flagged flicker when expanding inspector while timeline animation is active; initial triage with Eng (Rohit) shows event debounce regression from density refactor.

2026-02-27: Low-fidelity repro prototype created in Figma and Loom recording shared with stakeholders; recommended fix: re-introduce 80ms interaction guard on expand + stop-gap opacity layering to prevent content jump.

2026-03-02: Design deep-dive with Eng lead (Rohit Mehta) & PM (Liam Chen) — agreed trade-off: prefer non-blocking micro-delay vs full animation rewrite to meet cycle deadline; follow-up: produce motion spec and accessibility notes.

2026-03-05: High-fidelity prototype (compact + expanded states, reduced motion variant) uploaded to Figma; added focus outlines and aria-live annotations for screenreader feedback. Shared in design review channel and requested stakeholder review.

2026-03-08: Received stakeholder feedback: Security asks to ensure inspector content does not expose token fragments in preview; PM requests microcopy change for 'Rollback snapshot' CTA; Eng requests clear acceptance criteria for flakiness.

2026-03-10: Applied redlines from Design QA pass: increased contrast of header labels (AA compliance), adjusted hit target for expand toggle to 40px, added loading skeleton to avoid content shift during KV fetches.

2026-03-12: Prototype handoff packet prepared (Figma, motion spec, redline PDF, QA checklist). This ticket moved to In Review and requested signoff from PM/Eng/Security prior to scheduling canary with runtime-1.22 release.
decisions: Adopt 80ms interaction guard on expand action to debounce conflicting animations (chosen for minimal surface area change).
Implement loading skeleton and opacity layering to prevent content jump while KV cache responses arrive.
Provide reduced-motion variant controlled by user OS preference and a console-level toggle for power users.
Microcopy change: change CTA from 'Rollback snapshot' to 'Revert to snapshot' after PM discussion for clarity.
review_feedback: PM (Liam Chen): Accepts debounce approach; requested explicit acceptance criteria for flakiness (less than 1% reproduction on multiple runs).
Engineering (Rohit Mehta): Asks for a small e2e test to assert no content jump under artificial 200ms KV latency; wants feature flag for staged rollout.
Security (Priya Nair): Must ensure inspector preview never shows token IDs or PII in preview; approved redacted-preview pattern, asked to include automated screenshot check in CI.
Design QA (Elena Park): Requested precise redlines for header spacing and a 2px increase in divider contrast to meet WCAG AA at small sizes.
Accessibility (Darren Osei): Verified aria-live usage for state change announcements; flagged keyboard focus order on compact inspector when expanded — requires fix before canary.
follow_ups: ENG: Add feature flag and e2e tests (ENG-22994) — blocked until PR is merged.
QA: Run screenshot regression job and attach results to this ticket (due 2026-03-17).
DES: Finalize motion timings and export redline PDF for dev handoff (done 2026-03-12).
SEC: Add automated check to CI to validate no token-like strings render in inspector previews (security_review_required: true).
